g.text: Embedding: token ID → vector of numbers
Attention: tokens look at other tokens
Feed Forward: processes each token on its own
Linear + Softmax: score every possible word
Arrow going around a box = skip connection
Grey block is stacked N times
Number = row in the table below
Training: compare with “me gusta el fútbol </s>” → loss
Translating: pick the top word “fútbol” → feed it back in
Training: correct answer, shifted: “<s> me gusta el fútbol”
Translating: its own words so far: “<s> me gusta el”
Translating only: the predicted word is fed back in, and the decoder runs again
